title: Python: Async IO
description: Write a Python program that uses asyncio to run concurrent async tasks.

codeTemplate.py:
import asyncio

async def fetch_data(source, delay):
    print(f"Fetching from {source}...")
    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
    result = f"{source}: data"
    print(f"Received from {source}")
    return result

async def main():
    tasks = [
        fetch_data("API 1", 0.02),
        fetch_data("API 2", 0.01),
        fetch_data("API 3", 0.03),
    ]
    results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    print(f"All results: {results}")

asyncio.run(main())

verificationTest: output.includes('Fetching from API 1') && output.includes('Fetching from API 2') && output.includes('Fetching from API 3') && output.includes("All results: ['API 1: data', 'API 2: data', 'API 3: data']")
